import gzip,sys,collections
p,out=sys.argv[1:3]
opener=gzip.open if p.endswith((".gz",".bgz")) else open
samples=[]
n=snv=bial=0
first=[]
called=[0,0,0,0]; het=[0,0,0,0]; homalt=[0,0,0,0]
minp=None; maxp=None
with opener(p,"rt",errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith("##"):
            continue
        if line.startswith("#CHROM"):
            a=line.rstrip("\n").split("\t"); samples=a[9:]
            continue
        if line.startswith("#") or not line.strip():
            continue
        a=line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(a)<9: continue
        n+=1
        pos=int(a[1]); minp=pos if minp is None else min(minp,pos); maxp=pos if maxp is None else max(maxp,pos)
        if len(a[3])==1 and all(len(x)==1 for x in a[4].split(",")): snv+=1
        if "," not in a[4]: bial+=1
        fmt=a[8].split(":"); gi=fmt.index("GT") if "GT" in fmt else 0
        gts=[]
        for i,x in enumerate(a[9:13]):
            z=x.split(":"); gt=z[gi] if gi<len(z) else "."
            gts.append(gt)
            alleles=gt.replace("|","/").split("/")
            if len(alleles)==2 and all(y!="." for y in alleles):
                called[i]+=1
                if alleles[0]!=alleles[1]: het[i]+=1
                elif alleles[0]!="0": homalt[i]+=1
        if len(first)<20: first.append("\t".join([a[0],a[1],a[2],a[3],a[4]]+gts))
with open(out,"w") as w:
    w.write("samples\t"+",".join(samples)+"\n")
    w.write(f"variants\t{n}\nsnv_records\t{snv}\nbiallelic_records\t{bial}\nposition_range\t{minp}-{maxp}\n")
    for i,s in enumerate(samples[:4]):
        w.write(f"{s}\tcalled={called[i]}\thet={het[i]}\thomalt={homalt[i]}\n")
    w.write("first_records\n")
    w.write("\n".join(first)+"\n")

samples=[]; n=snv=bial=0; first=[]; called=[0]*4; het=[0]*4; homalt=[0]*4; minp=maxp=None
with opener(p,"rt",errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith("##"): continue
        if line.startswith("#CHROM"):
            a=line.rstrip("\n").split("\t"); samples=a[9:]; continue
        if line.startswith("#") or not line.strip(): continue
        a=line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(a)<9: continue
        n+=1; pos=int(a[1]); minp=pos if minp is None else min(minp,pos); maxp=pos if maxp is None else max(maxp,pos)
        if len(a[3])==1 and all(len(x)==1 for x in a[4].split(",")): snv+=1
        if "," not in a[4]: bial+=1
        fmt=a[8].split(":"); gi=fmt.index("GT") if "GT" in fmt else 0; gts=[]
        for i,x in enumerate(a[9:13]):
            z=x.split(":"); gt=z[gi] if gi<len(z) else "."; gts.append(gt)
            alleles=gt.replace("|","/").split("/")
            if len(alleles)==2 and all(y!="." for y in alleles):
                called[i]+=1
                if alleles[0]!=alleles[1]: het[i]+=1
                elif alleles[0]!="0": homalt[i]+=1
        if len(first)<20: first.append("\t".join([a[0],a[1],a[2],a[3],a[4]]+gts))
with open(out,"w") as w:
    w.write("samples\t"+",".join(samples)+"\n")
    w.write(f"variants\t{n}\nsnv_records\t{snv}\nbiallelic_records\t{bial}\nposition_range\t{minp}-{maxp}\n")
    for i,s in enumerate(samples[:4]): w.write(f"{s}\tcalled={called[i]}\thet={het[i]}\thomalt={homalt[i]}\n")
    w.write("first_records\n"+"\n".join(first)+"\n")

import urllib.request,collections,sys,csv
url="https://storage.googleapis.com/gcp-public-data--gnomad/release/3.1/secondary_analyses/hgdp_1kg/metadata_and_qc/gnomad_meta_v1.tsv"
out=sys.argv[1]
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
    lines=(x.decode("utf-8") for x in r)
    rd=csv.DictReader(lines,delimiter="\t")
    rows=list(rd)
cols=rd.fieldnames or []
with open(out,"w") as w:
    w.write("columns\t"+"|".join(cols)+"\n")
    w.write(f"rows\t{len(rows)}\n")
    keys=[c for c in cols if any(t in c.lower() for t in ("pop","region","ancestry","project"))]
    for k in keys:
        ctr=collections.Counter(x.get(k,"") for x in rows)
        w.write(k+"\t"+";".join(f"{a}:{b}" for a,b in ctr.most_common(100))+"\n")
